checks.coverage: 19 original waveform rows at 0 through 90 ns, all four binary input combinations

limitations: Development verification only; official evaluation was not accessed and remains pending.
Original waveform specifies binary inputs only; X/Z behavior is not part of the verified oracle.
implementation_basis: A uses the original Boolean formula. B uses XNOR inferred from every binary combination in the original waveform. Two instances of each feed the prescribed OR, AND, and final XOR.
